svg.title: ReCall: from bundled code to original logic
svg.desc: Illustrative recovery of an anonymous function in a minified webpack-style bundle: ReCall identifies lodash 4.17.21, resolves the bundling strategy, and links the function to its original isObject implementation.

g.text: From bundled code to original logic
Make captured website JavaScript understandable for further analysis.
Module boundaries obscured by the build.
Bundled function → original npm source implementation
